g.text: Configuration samples aggregate saved configurations and repeats; shared parameter samples count once per repeat.
Phases may overlap; medians must not be added. Zero stage medians: open triangles at recorded floor.
Slow fallback is additional work, not free. No old cached-matvec timings or speed ratios are used.
